quarterly_data.signal: Mastercard 10-K (fiscal 2025): net revenue $32,791 million, up 16% (payment network $19,476 million, up 12%; value-added services and solutions $13,315 million, up 23%); operating margin 57.6%; net income $14,968 million; diluted EPS $16.52. Gross dollar volume was $10.6T and switched transactions 175.5B. Its five largest customers generated approximately $6.9 billion, or 21%, of net revenue, and no individual customer generated more than 10% of net revenue. Value-added services carried $2.0 billion of unsatisfied performance obligations, expected to be recognized through 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: net revenue $32,791 million (+16%); five largest customers $6.9 billion (21%); GDV $10.6T

quarterly_data.signal: Mastercard 10-K, 2025 developments: it launched Mastercard Agent Pay, a framework for AI-assisted and fully automated agent-based payments across its acceptance network built on its tokenization (including Agentic Tokens), enabled all U.S.-based Mastercard cardholders in 2025 with a global launch scheduled for early 2026; approximately 40% of all Mastercard transactions are now tokenized; it supports crypto and stablecoin spending through approximately 130 crypto co-brand card programs; and it launched Mastercard Threat Intelligence, combining its network visibility with Recorded Future's cyber threat intelligence.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 40% of transactions tokenized; approximately 130 crypto co-brand card programs
